_comment: Optional human-checked catalyst overrides, keyed by session date then ticker. `text` is English, `zh` is Traditional Chinese. Delete an entry to fall back to automatic headline selection.

FROG.text: Q3 earnings blowout: revenue and guidance topped estimates, AI coding was the biggest growth driver, and BofA, RBC and Truist raised targets to about $120.
FROG.zh: 第三季業績遠超預期，收入及指引均勝預期，AI 編程為最大增長動力；美銀、RBC 及 Truist 先後上調目標價至約 120 美元。

IONQ.text: Q3 swung to a profit, revenue jumped 336% and the company raised full-year guidance.
IONQ.zh: 第三季轉虧為盈，收入按年大增 336%，並上調全年指引。

IREN.text: Fiscal Q1 showed strong AI cloud revenue growth and a 61% smaller net loss.
IREN.zh: 第一財季 AI 雲業務收入強勁增長，淨虧損收窄 61%。

DKNG.text: Cut its 2027 outlook on heavier prediction-business spending; BofA flagged a reset in expectations.
DKNG.zh: 下調 2027 年展望，主因預測市場業務開支增加；美銀指市場預期需要重置。

AXON.text: Q3 revenue miss plus a guidance cut, with delayed drone deals and a $1.2 billion Skydio bet weighing on the stock.
AXON.zh: 第三季收入遜預期兼下調指引，無人機訂單延誤及 12 億美元 Skydio 投資拖累股價。

TEAM.text: Fiscal 2027 growth outlook slowed sharply, overshadowing a Q1 earnings beat.
TEAM.zh: 2027 財年增長展望明顯放緩，蓋過第一季業績勝預期的利好。

AMD.text: Record quarterly revenue and a stronger growth outlook; led the chip rebound after Thursday's rout.
AMD.zh: 季度收入創新高，增長前景轉強；帶領晶片股從週四跌勢反彈。

ANET.text: Fastest growth since its IPO as Big Tech moves beyond Nvidia; rebounded with the AI-networking group.
ANET.zh: 上市以來最快增長，受惠大型科技企業逐步減少依賴 Nvidia；帶動 AI 網絡板塊反彈。

TSM.text: Reported to be weighing advanced memory-chip production for Nvidia; joined the broader chip rebound.
TSM.zh: 據報正考慮為 Nvidia 生產先進記憶體晶片；隨晶片板塊反彈。

CRM.text: No company-specific catalyst; software names stayed under pressure after the sector's AI-driven selloff.
CRM.zh: 暫無公司層面消息；軟件股在 AI 相關拋售後持續受壓。

MSFT.text: Reported pullback from key neocloud data-center deals added to AI-infrastructure caution.
MSFT.zh: 據報縮減與新興雲端業者的數據中心交易，加深市場對 AI 基建的審慎情緒。

2331.HK.text: No company-specific news; sportswear held up while the Hang Seng fell, led by technology.
2331.HK.zh: 暫無公司消息；恒指由科技股領跌，體育用品股逆市靠穩。

1347.HK.text: Defied the chip selloff after results and guidance beat expectations.
1347.HK.zh: 業績及指引勝預期，逆晶片股跌勢向上。

0883.HK.text: No company-specific news; edged higher as energy held up while Hong Kong tech sold off.
0883.HK.zh: 暫無公司消息；港股科技股下挫，能源股靠穩。

0981.HK.text: No company-specific news; tracked the global chip pullback and a Reuters report that Nvidia chips are piling up in Hong Kong.
0981.HK.zh: 暫無公司消息；跟隨全球晶片股回落，此前路透報道指 Nvidia 晶片在港積壓。

9988.HK.text: Slid as Hong Kong tech cooled after the Hunyuan-led rally; September-quarter results are due November 19.
9988.HK.zh: 港股科技股在混元帶動的反彈後降溫；9 月季度業績將於 11 月 19 日公布。

0992.HK.text: No company-specific news in the wires; slipped with the broader hardware and technology complex.
0992.HK.zh: 暫無公司消息；隨硬件及科技板塊整體回落。
